metadata.title: The influence of the secular perturbation of an intermediate-mass companion: II. Ejection of hypervelocity stars from the Galactic Center

notes: No eligible stars. The paper presents simulations of hypothetical stellar populations; its “candidate HVSs” (T:p6-b3) are simulated stars without individual stellar identifiers. IRS 13E is discussed only as a possible intermediate-mass companion (T:p2-b3), not as a Galactic unbound star, and observed HVSs are mentioned only as a generic population.
